title: Combinative Protein Expression of Immediate Early Genes c-Fos, Arc, and Npas4 Along Aversive and Appetitive Experience-Related Neural Networks.
authors: Arai, Mary; Osanai, Hisayuki; Snell, Chris C; Gawf, Kaylea E; Kitamura, Takashi; Ogawa, Sachie K
one_liner_zh: 该文研究即刻早期基因蛋白在脑区中的组合表达模式，属于神经记忆印迹的免疫组化分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Expression of immediate early genes (IEGs) is critical for memory formation and has been widely used to identify the neural substrate of memory traces, termed memory engram cells. Functions of IEGs have been known to be different depending on their types. However, there is limited knowledge about the extent to which different types of IEGs are selectively or concurrently involved in the formation of memory engram. To address this question, we investigated the combinative expression of c-Fos, Arc, and Npas4 proteins using immunohistochemistry following aversive and rewarding experiences across subregions in the prefrontal cortex (PFC), basolateral amygdala (BLA), hippocampal dentate gyrus (DG), and retrosplenial cortex (RSC). Using an automated cell detection algorithm, we found that expression patterns of c-Fos, Npas4, and Arc varied across different brain areas, with a higher increase of IEG expressing cells in the PFC and posterior BLA than in the DG. The combinative expression patterns, along with their experience-induced changes, also differed across brain areas; the co-expression of IEGs increased in the PFC and BLA following experience, whereas the increase was less pronounced in the DG and RSC. Furthermore, we demonstrate that different area-to-area functional connectivity networks were extracted by different IEGs. These findings provide insights into how different IEGs and their combinations identify engram cells, which will contribute to a deeper understanding of the functional significance of IEG-tagged memory engram cells.
abstract_zh: 即刻早期基因（IEGs）的表达对记忆形成至关重要，并已被广泛用于识别记忆痕迹的神经基质，即所谓的记忆印迹细胞。已知IEGs的功能因其类型不同而有所差异。然而，关于不同类型IEGs在记忆印迹形成中选择性或同时参与的程度，目前了解有限。为解决此问题，我们通过免疫组织化学方法，在厌恶和奖赏经历后，研究了前额叶皮层（PFC）、基底外侧杏仁核（BLA）、海马齿状回（DG）和压后皮层（RSC）各亚区中c-Fos、Arc和Npas4蛋白的组合表达。利用自动化细胞检测算法，我们发现c-Fos、Npas4和Arc的表达模式在不同脑区存在差异，其中PFC和后部BLA中IEG表达细胞的增加幅度高于DG。组合表达模式及其经历诱导的变化在不同脑区也有所不同；经历后PFC和BLA中IEG的共表达增加，而DG和RSC中的增加则不那么显著。此外，我们证明不同IEGs提取了不同的区域间功能连接网络。这些发现揭示了不同IEGs及其组合如何识别印迹细胞，这将有助于更深入地理解IEG标记的记忆印迹细胞的功能意义。
